changes: Authenticated and tenant-scoped all exposed approval HTTP routes and public in-process methods. Enforced operation-specific human, requester/manager, revocation-role and workload checks with denial audit; explicit tenant query targets require authorized scope.

Bound executor consumption to the authenticated workload matching the request's SPIFFE ID and recorded that identity as consumption actor. HTTP authorization requires a workload bearer token; request body identity and group claims cannot grant privilege.

Moved raw persistence operations into a frozen construction-time capability delivered separately to trusted composition code. Public objects no longer expose live request maps, stores, audit ledgers, raw server handles or internal capabilities; returned snapshots and mutable caller inputs are isolated.

Added HTTP/direct-service regressions for positive and denied tenant access, role-before-expiry ordering, forged identity/training/approved state, duplicate IDs/approvers, human/workload separation, unowned internal requests, denial audit, and legitimate view/decision/withdraw flows. Updated runtime callers to pass authenticated workload identity.
limitations: Independent technical verification passed at source SHA 1ec0b96615bf2e4b9434bcc88a345fb12afbf563; human acceptance is pending. This source is not merged or deployed. GitHub CI was not run.

The separate persistence suite has 78/80 passing on the candidate. The two runtime-jobs expected statuses (completed and escalated) instead return denied; both failures reproduce on baseline 7bd3626, and are inherited fail-closed classification behavior assigned to S1-05. Independent verification reports approval-service-restart 3/3 passing.

The final R3 probe denies earlier on unknown/unavailable protection classification, before reaching the approval-threshold scenario. S1-03 does not claim R3 threshold closure; S1-04 remains the threshold task.

Windows runtime/conformance aggregate execution was not completed because the Windows checkout lacked ajv. Focused approvals and approval-conformance suites passed on Windows; the full Linux suite passed.
